root_cause.text: Pages allocated before page_ext is initialized have no codetag set, causing a spurious WARNING when they are freed because the alloc_tag reference is still NULL.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains that "page_ext is allocated and initialized relatively late during boot... Some pages have already been allocated and freed before page_ext becomes available, leaving their codetag uninitialized." The patch adds `alloc_tag_add_early_pfn()` to track these early PFNs and later clears their codetag refs to CODETAG_EMPTY in `clear_early_alloc_pfn_tag_refs()`. Additionally, the diff in `__pgalloc_tag_get()` adds a check `!is_codetag_empty(&ref)` to avoid treating an empty ref as valid (since the early pages now have CODETAG_EMPTY).
